title: DETOXIFYING TOXIC COMMUNICATION: A DESIGN SCIENCE APPROACH TO RESPONSIBLE AI
reasoning: The paper focuses on detecting and detoxifying toxic organizational communication (e.g., sarcasm, pejoratives, incivility) using language models. While it incorporates principles of 'Responsible AI' and discusses bias and fairness, it does not evaluate or benchmark specific ethical frameworks, moral reasoning, ethical dilemmas, or religious concepts.
